name: BSD Zero Clause License (XZ Utils liblzma)
content:
XZ Utils licensing (liblzma)

liblzma is in the public domain.

From XZ Utils' COPYING file (v5.8.4,
https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/blob/v5.8.4/COPYING):

    "liblzma is in the public domain.

    [...]

    You can do whatever you want with the files that have been put
    into the public domain. If you find public domain legally
    problematic, take the previous sentence as a license grant."

The public-domain dedication inside liblzma's source files (Lasse
Collin and the other XZ Utils authors) reads:

    This file has been put into the public domain.
    You can do whatever you want with this file.

(Python-build-standalone records liblzma's licence as 0BSD in its
build metadata; the SPDX 0BSD text is the OSI-approved public-domain
equivalent used here.)
